text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorryyy! It's all my fault...
Because of my miscommunication... the assistant hasn't arrived~~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to apologize. However... hmm.
We need at least one more person, otherwise...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh! If it isn't Trainer-san!
What exquisite timing! Lend us a hand!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
—And those are the cues for sound effects.
That is all you must do. Simple, is it not?
choice_data_list: S-So all I have to do is...

text_block_list.text:
I respond while handling the audio equipment. Apparently,
they were looking for extra hands for their puppet show.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bravo! Then let us begin the dress rehearsal!
Let us perfect 'The Puppets' Odeon'!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava! Then let us begin the dress rehearsal!
Let us perfect 'The Puppets' Odeon'!

text_block_list.name: Puppets
text_block_list.text:
"Sing of the stars~♪ Spin the wide skies~♪
A world where friends abide~♪ Here is paradise~♪"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Doto? Doto!? ...Oh no!
My friend! She's stopped moving!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"—Naturally! For the supreme sovereign ruler
has ceased manipulating you all!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me...!? No way... A horse girl as beautiful
as this exists beside myself...!?"
choice_data_list: (W-What kind of chaotic play is this...?!)

text_block_list.text: Even though it's a puppet show, they're acting as themselves and conversing with puppets! Yet thanks to the bizarre storyline, it never gets boring—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! Have you had prior experience in sound engineering?
Please maintain this standard for the real performance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us depart!
To deliver the radiant light known as myself! —To the hospital!
choice_data_list: The hospital...? You're performing this play at a hospital?
The hospital...? You're performing this play at a hospital?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes~...
Actually, some time ago...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I met a fan in town...
That person works as a nurse...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She was troubled because 'the children in the hospital have no entertainment.' Hearing that, Opera O-san said—
'My stage awaits.'

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...It's truly such a noble sentiment that
it's an absolute honor just to help out...!!
Even if I'm just filling in, I resolve to give my all in assisting with the puppet show she prepared.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I have finally realized... You all made me see it.
All that I ever wanted—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "—was a friend."

(Waaaah—!!!)
(Clap-clap-clap-clap!!)
The moment the final line is delivered, cheers and applause erupt from the children. —They felt they had witnessed something truly wonderful. That feeling radiated from everyone present.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-hah-hah-hah! A resounding success, an absolute triumph!
Well, seeing as it is my production, that is only natural!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Indeed, is it not! Is it not!
Come, shower me with even greater praise!

I praise her not just for the excellence of the play,
but for putting it together for the children,
including her charitable heart, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A charitable heart? What is that?
I possess not a single shred of such a thing.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. That is so.
After all—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I merely did what is natural.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Why does a lighthouse exist? Why does the sun shine? Indeed,
I merely shone dazzlingly bright for my own sake!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that purpose, I can achieve anything.
It is as effortless as breathing. Not burdensome in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For that is the effort required for me to remain myself!
In other words, what occurred today was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The sun illuminating the world.
—Merely that, and nothing more.
Overwhelmed by such a blindingly radiant philosophy, standing before a conqueror whose very soul is beautiful, few words could adequately reply—
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your next puppet show!

text_block_list.text:
I was completely overwhelmed by such a dazzling philosophy.
Standing before the Supreme Overlord whose heart was equally beautiful,
there were few words I could offer in return—
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to your next puppet show!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Did my message not get across?
As I said, it is not kindness, but—
choice_data_list: No, you are kind. Doing it for your own self-satisfaction makes it so.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, fascinating! Truly fascinating, Trainer-san!
To think you would interpret me in such a way!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I have taken quite a liking to you!
How about it? Alongside the girl you currently train,
why not become my Trainer as well?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It seems you are already utterly captivated by my play.
Ah, what a sinful soul I am...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fear not, for of course I plan to stage
a second and third performance as well.
You may wait with high expectations!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall never betray anyone's expectations!
